name: The internet
kid: The internet is lots of networks holding hands. Tap it to see what’s inside!
nerd: ~75 000 autonomous systems exchanging routes with BGP. Tap to unfold the path through the ISP.

inside.title: Inside the internet
inside.kid: The internet isn’t one big cloud. It’s a chain of boxes, each passing your parcel to the next one – from your street, through your internet company, to where the video lives.
inside.nerd: A chain of networks: your access network, your internet company’s core, then settlement-free peering at an internet exchange (or paid transit), ending at a CDN cache close to you.
